big_case.notes: Pro se APA challenge by one former employee to his debarment from a single DLA installation; unpublished Fourth Circuit affirmance below, Solicitor General waived, denied without noted dissent at the first conference the petition itself reached. The record-rule exceptions question has some abstract general importance, but this petition would not have been the vehicle to settle it, and the decision binds no one beyond the petitioner.
